# Neo Brutalism React

> Neo Brutalism React is a neo-brutalist React UI library by Rahmat Ashari. Built with composable primitives, hooks-friendly patterns, and Tailwind v4. It ships as neobrutalism-ui-react. Bold borders, offset shadows, punchy colors.

- Author: Rahmat Ashari (https://github.com/rahmatez)
- Repository: https://github.com/rahmatez/neo-brutalism-react
- License: MIT

## Pages

- [Neo Brutalism React — Neo-Brutalist React UI Library](https://neo-brutalism-react-docs.vercel.app/): Neo Brutalism React is a neo-brutalist React UI primitive library and composition system for building loud interfaces with Surface, Section, Stack, Cluster, Split, actions, forms, media, and recipes.
- [Portfolio Showcase | Neo Brutalism React](https://neo-brutalism-react-docs.vercel.app/showcase/portfolio/): Portfolio showcase built with Neo Brutalism React primitives, OpenLayers map, and neo-brutalist layout patterns.

- [Installation | Neo Brutalism React](https://neo-brutalism-react-docs.vercel.app/docs/installation/): Install neobrutalism-ui-react in your React project. Requires React 18+, Tailwind v4, and Node 20+.
- [Inspired Designs | Neo Brutalism React](https://neo-brutalism-react-docs.vercel.app/docs/inspired-designs/): Explore the visual references behind Neo Brutalism React: loud layouts, chunky borders, bold color, and React UI patterns with bite.
